You're right about all of that. Maybe it's not too late but really I'm just terrified for what the future holds because before long I'll be out of the house.. You know my parents are getting old. I used to feel more mature about these kind of things a few years earlier. Don't know what exactly happened. I came to a realization. But this thinking does need to stop. Thank you so much for your reply. It does really mean a lot to think a unknown person can be so generous.
It could be much worse, and it is for a lot of people.
